summary: No Forest Service or BLM page designates dispersed sites at Homestake Pass; only aggregators (Campendium, The Dyrt, Boondockers Bible, RV Life) describe it. Cleared the derived free/FCFS/16-day/no-electric values, which rested only on those. The nearby FS Homestake Picnic Area is day use only and says nothing about camping beyond it. Note left as is.
flags: No agency page: no fs.usda.gov or blm.gov page designates or describes dispersed camping at Homestake Pass (searched 2026-10-22); the entry's website is empty. Inclusion rests on RV Life and aggregator reports. The managing office would be the Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF Butte Ranger District, 406-494-2147 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/homestake-picnic-area).

Status lead: one Campendium map listing marks 'Homestake Pass Dispersed Camping' as 'Permanently Closed' (https://maps.campendium.com/us/butte-mt/nature/homestake-pass-dispersed-camping), while other aggregator reviews (The Dyrt, March 2026) describe it in use with a potholed road. Aggregator only, so no status written; a human should check with the Butte Ranger District.
Nearby Homestake Picnic Area (FS, exit 233) is 'day use only'; the camping is said to be on the dirt roads beyond it, which no agency page confirms are drivable by a 23-ft non-4WD motorhome.
